cert_paths.comment: Filesystem paths to PEM certificates. On Windows: C:\certs\aegis-ca.pem etc. Empty here: test material is issued in-crate by rcgen (FED-P2A).

kill_switch.comment: OFF by default. Delegate dials only when enabled; test-only until P4 wiring.

platform_behavior.comment: One stack on every platform since P2B2; no mock transport remains.
platform_behavior.linux: Real TLS via Rust rustls (FFI delegate)
platform_behavior.windows: Real TLS via Rust rustls (FFI delegate)

tls_params.comment: mTLS enforced in Rust (WebPkiClientVerifier); empty roots fail closed.

validation.revocation_note: CRL/OCSP not enforced by the Rust stack; P4 deployment concern.
